data.description: This is the Anime Adventures main map with NPC's pointed out with their functions included.

popup.title: Summons
popup.description: Place where you can buy new units.

popup.title: Travelling Merchant Shop
popup.description: Place where you can buy star fruits and other items with gems from Bulmy. (Shop last for an hour and re-appear every half hour)

popup.title: Limited New World Shop
popup.description: Place where you can buy special stuff with evo items gained from newest world (Legend Stage/Portal from infinite mode)

popup.title: Leaderboard Unit supplier
popup.description: talk to all-might to claim your leaderboard unit (if applicable)

popup.title: Gilgamesh
popup.description: Craft Relics using materials from Legend Stages, Raids and coins

popup.title: Hubris Shop
popup.description: Purchase XP foods and Stars with gold. Can also purchase unit/skin store with gold. (Also place for selling robux stuffs)

popup.title: Raid Item Shop
popup.description: Place where you purchase the raid's special items from this shop that required for evolving units

popup.title: Story/infinite/legend stage mode teleporter
popup.description: Place where teleports you to a story mode battle with a max team of 4 players (Only Infinite mode and legend stage has matchmaking)

popup.title: Event Teleporter
popup.description: Teleport you to the main dungeon of the event where the max players are 6 (Has Matchmaking)

popup.title: Raid teleporter
popup.description: Place where teleports you to a raid with the max players being 4 (Has Matchmaking)

popup.title: Event NPC (Nami)
popup.description: NPC which you can access to purchase evo items and capsule stars using special event currencies

popup.title: Trait Roller
popup.description: Rolls or rerolls your unit traits with robux or star remnants.

popup.title: Evo Item Crafter
popup.description: Place to craft evo materials using star fruits and other resources (Cost coins to craft)

popup.title: Infinity Castle Teleport
popup.description: Teleports you to infinity castle (teleports within the same server, has separate map).

popup.title: Six Eyes Crafter
popup.description: Teleports you to the six eyes crafter (Must have Paradox, separate map)

popup.title: Time Machine
popup.description: Place where you can AFK for gems (Currently not working)

popup.title: Shiny Remover
popup.description: Removes Shiny status from Shiny Units. Removing Shiny from legendaries, mythics and secret units gives Star Remnants

popup.title: Evolution Chamber
popup.description: Evolve units here.

popup.title: Codes
popup.description: Place where you Input special codes for certain rewards

popup.title: Challenges teleporter
popup.description: Place where you will be teleport to a story match with a modifier. Reward contains Star fruits, Gems and has a chance for a star remnant to appear.

popup.title: Event NPC
popup.description: Place where you can access event NPC that only appear in a limited time

popup.title: Daily Challenge Teleporter
popup.description: Place where teleport you to a specific challenge that rotate everyday with buffed enemies and has a cap of 6 players at max (Has Matchmaking)

popup.title: Limit Break
popup.description: Place where you can extend your max level unit with new extra levels and additional buff.

popup.title: Dungeon (Curse Womb) Teleporter
popup.description: Place where you will be teleported to Haunted Academy with Curse Womb modifier, used for get Curse Token (Required 1  key Curse Womb each run)

popup.title: Mission (Zen)
popup.description: NPC which you can talk to accept quest that required 3000 kills, reward you with gems and evo items and last for 24h

popup.title: Tournament
popup.description: Place where you can participate tournament run, rise on leaderboards for gems, star remnant or a chance to get exclusive unit every week.

popup.title: Trait/Stats Transferer
popup.description: NPC which you can talk to either transfer trait to same unit or transfer stats between same rarity units

popup.title: Level Milestone (Prayer Master)
popup.description: NPC which you interact to receive rewards from reaching certain levels.
